title: Daily briefing: Bleached corals revived by healthy neighbour’s touch
title_zh: 每日简报：健康邻居的触感使白化珊瑚复活
abstract: Ghostly white corals are fully restored in eight weeks by contact with a healthy counterpart. Plus, arXiv is capping submissions per researcher and four good news stories to brighten your day.
abstract_zh: 健康对接触后，幽灵般苍白的珊瑚在八周内完全恢复。此外，arXiv 正在限制每位研究人员的提交量，还有四则值得开心的好消息。
snippet: Ghostly white corals are fully restored in eight weeks by contact with a healthy counterpart. Plus, arXiv is capping submissions per researcher and four good news stories to brighten your day.
